name: polycube
draw: A few equal cubes joined face to face into an L shaped block, drawn in isometric view.

name: annular-sector
draw: A curved block cut from a ring: two arcs of different radii joined by two short straight ends.

name: extrude
draw: A flat hexagon on the bottom with an upward arrow and a hexagonal prism rising from it.

name: polyline
draw: An open chain of straight line segments zigzagging across, with a dot at every joint and both ends.

name: pyramid-frustum
draw: A square pyramid with its top sliced off flat, leaving a smaller square top face in perspective.

name: parabolic-focus
draw: A parabola with several parallel incoming lines bouncing off its inner curve and meeting at one focus dot.

name: vector-projection
draw: Two arrows from a shared start point with a dashed line dropped at a right angle from one tip onto the other.

name: miura-fold
draw: A sheet folded into a zigzag grid of slanted parallelograms, like an accordion folded map.

name: coastline-paradox
draw: A jagged coastline outline measured by a chain of straight ruler segments hugging its edge.

name: hollow-cylinder
draw: A thick walled tube shown upright, its top face a ring between an outer and inner ellipse.

name: quadtree
draw: A square split into four quadrants, with one quadrant split again into four and one of those split once more.

name: unit-cell
draw: A wireframe cube with a small ball at each of its eight corners, as in a crystal lattice.

name: fraser-spiral-illusion
draw: Concentric rings made of short slanted segments over a patterned background, looking like a spiral.

name: zollner-illusion
draw: Several long parallel lines crossed by short slanted hatch marks in alternating directions, appearing tilted.

name: oblique-cone
draw: A cone whose apex leans off to one side, not directly above the center of its round base.

name: oblique-cylinder
draw: A cylinder whose top ellipse is shifted sideways from its base, the sides leaning at a slant.

name: cyclic-quadrilateral
draw: An irregular four sided shape drawn inside a circle with all four corners on the circle.

name: triangle-midsegment
draw: A triangle with a line joining the midpoints of two sides, parallel to the base, midpoints marked with ticks.

name: cube-space-diagonal
draw: A see-through cube with a line running from one bottom front corner to the opposite top back corner.

name: truncated-hexagonal-tiling
draw: A tiling of large dodecagons with small triangles filling the gaps where three of them meet.

name: folium-of-descartes
draw: A curve that forms a closed leaf shaped loop at the origin and trails off in two tails toward a dashed slanted line.

name: sander-illusion
draw: A large and a small parallelogram joined side by side, each crossed by a diagonal that are really equal in length.

name: spherical-wedge
draw: A segment of a sphere shaped like an orange slice, with two flat half circle faces meeting at an edge.
